title: Fanin bound for recursive circuit combination
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b$ specify an AND or OR gate, and let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables. For every natural number $k$ with $|cs|\le k$, the circuit obtained by recursively combining the list with fuel $k$ has maximum fanin at most the larger of $2$ and the greatest fanin among circuits in $cs$, taking that greatest fanin to be $0$ when the list is empty.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of circuits on $n$ variables
